title: Rare-book theft ring and the burning of stolen books
place_text: New York / North America (US, Canada, Mexico)

tellings.quote: they were arrested for committing the largest rare book theft in America's history.

plain: In the early 1970s a group of people Peter Levenda knew were arrested for "the largest rare book theft in America's history", and some of the stolen books were burned. Levenda, introduced on the show as a CIA historian, tells Michels this as something he saw up close in New York at the time. He ties it to the same circle as other stories he tells from those years, about children who gained psychic powers and a UFO research group.
